title: Headbar Implantation Procedure
author: Liu Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcrsiv6e
materials: If applicable, perform the virus injection protocol here.
Spray the headbar with 70% ethanol to disinfect.

steps.title: Disinfect work area
steps.instruction: Spray the stereotax and surrounding bench top area with Virkon 1 % solution, wipe down all surfaces, then wipe the metal with 70 % ethanol to remove all residues.

steps.title: Power on equipment
steps.instruction: Turn on all machines including the self‑regulating heating pad and light source; check oxygen and isoflurane levels and refill if needed; set the heat source to 37‑38 °C.

steps.title: Induce anesthesia
steps.instruction: Place the animal in the induction chamber with O₂ flow 1 L/min and 2.5‑3.0 % isoflurane for 3‑4 min until breathing slows to ~1 breath/sec; flush the chamber with O₂ for 15‑30 s before opening, then switch anesthesia delivery to the nose‑cone.

steps.title: Secure animal on stereotax
steps.instruction: Move the animal to the nose‑cone on the stereotax, shift the tongue aside with plastic hemostats, place the upper teeth into the tooth‑bar hole and lock the nose‑cone; decrease isoflurane to a maintenance level of ~1.75‑2 % with O₂ flow 0.5‑0.8 L/min; continuously monitor respiration (1 breath/1‑2 s), pink mucous membranes, loss of muscle tone and loss of pedal reflex, adjusting isoflurane as necessary.

steps.title: Fix head and give analgesia
steps.instruction: Fix the animal into the head‑bars ensuring the head is stable, straight, and perpendicular to the nose‑cone; administer buprenorphine 0.1 mg/kg and ketoprofen 5 mg/kg according to the animal’s weight.

steps.title: Prepare scalp
steps.instruction: Shave the head and wipe away excess hair; apply eye lubricant to each eye with a cotton‑tip applicator; cleanse the surgical area by alternating ethanol and betadine three times each with a cotton tip or gauze, avoiding the eyes; make a midline scalp incision from between the ears to between the eyes using iris scissors; clean the periosteum with forceps and cut any protruding hairs with small scissors; optionally clear remaining debris with a sterile cotton‑tip applicator.

steps.title: Apply temporary glue and level head
steps.instruction: Using a sterile cotton‑tip applicator broken in half as a spatula, apply Krazy glue to the skull area where the headbar will be attached; wait 10 minutes for the glue to dry while leveling the animal’s head.

steps.title: Mark fiducial points
steps.instruction: Under the microscope, mark Bregma and Lambda with a marker; use the micromanipulator and needle tip to locate additional fiducial markers on the skull and mark them with a permanent marker.

steps.title: Inject local anesthetic
steps.instruction: Inject 0.05 mL of 0.5 % Marcaine under the scalp around the future incision site.

steps.title: Detach animal and recover
steps.instruction: Turn off isoflurane and remove the mouse from the ear‑bars (oxygen may remain on for a short period if surgery exceeds 1 hour); remove the animal from the stereotax and place it on a heating pad to recover; turn off oxygen.

steps.title: Post‑operative care
steps.instruction: Administer postoperative ketoprofen 5 mg/kg daily for 2 days; if surgery lasted >60 min, inject warm saline subcutaneously between the shoulder blades; if needed, increase isoflurane by 0.25‑0.5 % before retesting after 30 s; assess pedal reflex by pinching both hind feet and observing stable breathing.

steps.title: Level head with micromanipulator
steps.instruction: Attach a sharp needle to the micromanipulator; gently lower the needle tip until it contacts Bregma; zero the manipulator reading and move the needle tip to Lambda; if the DV difference between Bregma and Lambda exceeds 50 µm, tilt the head accordingly and repeat until the head is level between Bregma and Lambda.

steps.title: Create bonding surface
steps.instruction: Scratch the skull at the intended head‑bar attachment sites and near the skin with a scalpel blade to roughen the surface; apply Krazy glue on the edge of the incision, push the skin back to seal the wound and increase surface area, ensuring a complete seal; clean the bone with cortex buffer and dry with sterile cotton‑tip applicators.

steps.title: Mount headbar
steps.instruction: Clamp the head‑bar holder onto the manipulator arm with its orientation parallel to the ear‑bars; place the headbar onto the skull and apply a thick layer of Krazy glue over it; wait 10 minutes for the glue to cure; release the headbar from the holder.

steps.title: Build recording well
steps.instruction: Apply dental cement (acrylic) in thin successive layers to sculpt a recording well surrounding the skull and headbar, avoiding bubbles; seal the interior of the well and cover the skull underneath with single‑use Krazy glue to fill any gaps; the glue cures quickly upon contact with wet acrylic.

steps.title: Seal well and finish assembly
steps.instruction: Fill the well with Kwik‑Cast and cover it with a thin layer of dental cement to prevent Kwik‑Cast loss; assemble the head‑bar holder (J001375 KS style headpost with three epoxy holes), place the head‑bar in the holder and fasten the side screws.

steps.title: Final head leveling – AP axis
steps.instruction: After the head is leveled in the AP axis, move the needle tip 2 mm left of Bregma; zero the manipulator and move the needle tip 2 mm right of Bregma; if the DV difference between Bregma ± 2 mm exceeds 40 µm, tilt the head around the AP axis and repeat until the head is level between Bregma ± 2 mm.
